title: Abu Tha'alba
content:
{{orphan|date=January 2025}}
'''Abu Tha'alba''' ({{langx|ar|أبو ثعلبة}}), was one of the [[Sahaba|companions]] of [[Muhammad]] and [[narrators of hadith|narrator of hadith]], quoted in ''[[Sahih al-Bukhari]]'', the most prominent source of [[Hadith]] among Sunni Muslims.<ref>{{Hadith-usc|Bukhari|usc=yes|7|67|435}}</ref>
